Resolves #21477

🌿 *A streamed answer can no longer render differently from the same answer pasted whole.*

The markdown example's stream demo cut "Streaming Markdown, VDOM-native" and "Why transcripts need this" into a heading and a paragraph each, and drew its table without a head, with the paragraph's text left inside the table. The parser now keeps a heading open while its line arrives, and a paragraph, list, quote or table open while it stops at or runs into the unfinished last line, which can still become a row, a continuation or another block; an append re-parses from the end of the settled prefix. A block that changes type becomes a new block under a fresh id, and every child id carries its node's kind, so no id can name two kinds of node across a stream.

Evidence: L3 (an invariant spec over seven chunk sizes and ten documents, red on `dev` and on `a5f30a05da`, green here; the streaming coherence e2e; the stream demo shot on `dev`'s parser and on this head, with a DOM receipt) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-4). Residual: none.

      **Commit:** b975c89143
      **Details:** The last line has not ended, so a paragraph, list, quote or table that stops at it or runs into it now stays open (`reachesEnd = end >= lines.length - 1`). An append re-parses from the end of the settled prefix (`#settledEnd`), not from the last block alone, so leading whitespace is parsed with the line it starts, and both open blocks are re-parsed together; a new block keeps the id of the open block at its position when the type stays the same. *   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with **Verify-Before-Assert** and **Body/Brain transcript integrity**: agent responses in `Neo.component.markdown.Component` stream chunk-wise, so streamed VDOM convergence with one-shot parsing is load-bearing.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: Running the PR's AC-1 chunk-size loop (`[1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 24]`) against `Parser.mjs` at `a5f30a05da` exposes two remaining unfinished-last-line streaming divergences from one-shot `update(source)`:
  1. **Unfinished whitespace-only trailing line (`[ \t]+` without `\n`):** `reachesEnd` checks `lines.at(-1) === ''`, whereas `#opensBlock` tests `REGEX_BLANK` (`/^[ \t]*$/`). When a chunk ends inside leading spaces of the next line:
     - Soft-wrapped list continuation (`- alpha\n- beta\n  continues here\n`, from `Parser.spec.mjs:220`) fails at `size = 1, 2` (`<ul>` settles at `'beta'`, stranding `<p>continues here</p>`).
     - Indented list items (`- alpha\n  - beta\n  - gamma\n`), indented paragraphs (`first line\n  second line\n`), indented quotes (`> line one\n  > line two\n`), and space-indented table rows (`| a | b |\n  |---|---|\n  | 1 | 2 |\n`) split into separate blocks / `<p>` tags (`size = 1, 2, 3, 5, 11, 24`).
     - After a settled block, `#segment` skips an unfinished whitespace-only line while `me.#source = source` advances past it (`source.slice(previous.length)`), eating indentation so `# Title\n\n    - four spaces not a list\n` becomes `<ul>` (`size = 1, 2, 3, 5, 11`) and `# Title\n\n # Not a heading\n` becomes `<h1>` (`size = 1, 2, 5`) instead of `<p>`.
  2. **Unfinished non-blank trailing line settling the preceding block (`outer pipes optional`, `Parser.mjs:85`):** Streaming `Surface | Layer\n---|---\nParser | App Worker\nDeltas | Main\n` fails at `size = 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 24` (and `| a | b |\n---|---\n| 1 | 2 |\n` fails at `size = 1`): at `'Surface | Layer\n---'` (before `'|---'` arrives), `'---'` provisionally matches `REGEX_BREAK`, settling `'Surface | Layer'` (`open: false`) before its delimiter line completes; similarly, at `'...---|---\nParser'` (before `' | App Worker'` arrives), `!lines[index].includes('|')` settles the `<table>` and strands the row as `<p>`.
